generation.policy: One attempt per author and family; require EOS, no wrappers or line breaks, one exact app-segmented sentence, 0.60–1.50 target words and at least 12, no more than .25 eight-token target copy, no prior or other source normalized 12-token overlap. Require the final TXT to pass the published one-paragraph, English, four-sentence, 68–134-word serving gate.

sources.extraction: Original English direct body paragraphs from div.entry, XPath paragraph indexes count all descendants. Collapse internal whitespace. Where the excerpt crosses an adjacent plain paragraph boundary, join with a single space to match the local one-paragraph TXT gate. Positions are half-open Unicode codepoints in each normalized publisher paragraph.
